feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 10:21pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 10:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near southern Denmark, soon transferring southeast. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

Southwest or south-southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight, then 3 or 4 occasional 5 during Friday evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate at first, falling slight or moderate, then becoming mostly slight later on Friday.


##Weather##

Mist patches at first, becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in places at first, becoming generally good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest or south-southwest 3 or 4, occasional 5, backing mainly south 4 or 5 into Saturday afternoon, then occasionally 6 in central parts of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mostly moderate in western & central parts of the area later in the period.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then periods of rain or drizzle spreading from the west.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle, also poor in mist later on Saturday.
